title: chu-space-over-four
description: A relation (A, r, X) presented as a carrier readable as rows and columns and dualizable, with r a total cell-read into the four-bilattice alphabet FOUR; generated by valuing a Chu space in FOUR, so each cell is a knowledge/truth charge and the whole is the kernel-backed shape shared by EAVT memory, office tables, and readiness.

points.description: A, the finite ordered list of named points (rows); a point's row is its costate, what it asserts across states

states.description: X, the finite ordered list of named states (columns); a state's column is the transpose read the row-read does not give for free

cell.description: r(a, x), the total cell-read valuing each point-state pair in FOUR, the Belnap-Ginsberg four-valued bilattice

absent.description: the per-space default FOUR value for cells outside the matrix: f (closed-world, absence is the negative charge) or bottom (open-world, absence is unwitnessed)

dual.description: the space dualizes by transpose-and-negate: C-perp = (X, not r-transpose, A) with absent also negated; dual of dual = id, claimed to be linear-logic / *-autonomous negation over the self-dual alphabet
